messages.subject: Spatial Multi-Scale Model
parts:
Hi All,

I'm currently attempting to construct a customized spatial multi-scale model in JAGS. The end goal is to be able model the response (functional diversity) at two spatial extents (stream reach (y), and watershed (Y)). Also, within the likelihood portion of the model at the stream reach scale, I'm modeling y as an effect of flow across two seasons (spring and summer). Ideally, I've structured this portion of the model accordingly to reflect the assumption on my part that the effect of flow on y will vary across seasons.  I'm modeling the y and Y under the assumption that they would fit a beta distribution (they are proportions). Any thoughts on where I'm going wrong? I know this isn't super advanced, but I'm still very much a novice when it comes to constructing hierarchical models in JAGS.  JAGS Code and data are below.

Thanks!

Josh

#Upload Data
data<-read.csv("CEAP_Data.csv", header = T)

IBI<- data[,2]/100
HUC12<- as.factor(data[,7])
Season<- as.factor(data[,5])
Flow<- standardize(data[,14])
n<-168
y<-IBI
HUC12_IBI<- aggregate(IBI~HUC12, FUN=mean)
Y<-HUC12_IBI[,-1]

## Future Random Effects Model (Null CEAP Model Structure) To Remove Variance 
#Associated With River System and Stream Size (Stream Size is Nested within River System)
#JAGS Data
jags.data<-list(y=y, Y=Y, n.sites=n, n.hucs = max(as.integer(HUC12)), Season=as.integer(Season), Flow=Flow, ncat=2)

########################
########################
require(jagsUI)
sink("model.txt")
cat("
 model{
 ##priors
 
#Parameters  
 phi1~ dgamma(0.1,0.1)
 phi2~ dgamma(0.1,0.1)
 
 #HUC12 Priors
 L1_alpha ~ dnorm(0, 0.001)

 #Catchment Priors
 L2_alpha ~ dnorm(0, 0.001)
 L2_beta2 ~ dnorm(0, 0.001)
 
 for (i in 1:ncat){
 L2_beta1[i,k] ~ dnorm(0, 0.001)
 L2_beta3[i,k] ~ dnorm(0,0.001)
 }
 
 #likelihood, Watershed (HUC12) Scale (Level 1)
  for(i in 1:n.hucs) {
  Y[i] ~ dbeta(A[i], B[i])
  A[i] <- MU[i] * phi1
  B[i]  <- (1-MU[i]) * phi1
  logit(MU[i])<- L1_alpha
  }
 
 #likelihood, Stream Reach Scale (NHDPlus COMID) (Level 2) 
  for(j in 1:n.sites) {
  y[i,j] ~ dbeta(a[i,j], b[i,j])
  a[i,j] <- mu[i,j] * phi2
  b[i,j]  <- (1-mu[i,j]) * phi2
  logit(mu[i,j])<- L2_alpha + L2_beta1[Season[i,j]] + L2_beta2*Flow[i,j] + L2_beta3[Season[i,j]] * Flow[i,j]
  }
  }
  ",fill=TRUE)
sink()

##Parameters to Estimate
params<-c("L1_alpha", "L2_alpha", "L2_beta1", "L2_beta2", "L2_beta3")

model <- jagsUI(data=jags.data, parameters.to.save=params, 
                model.file="model.txt",n.thin =5,n.chains = 3, 
                n.burnin = 100, n.iter =1000,parallel=TRUE)
